# files

## single file

```{bash}
mineru -p ./input/pdf1.pdf -o ./output/mark1/
mineru -p report.docx -o output
mineru -p slides.pptx -o output
mineru -p table.xlsx -o output
```

## folder

```{bash}
micromamba activate -p .CondaPkg/.pixi/envs/default # run CIL in current environment.
# install the model firstly.
export MINERU_MODEL_SOURCE=modelscope
mineru -p ./input/ -o ./output/ -b pipeline -l en
```
